notes: Wenna the Fence sold you the hiding place. The packet was in a hollow oak.
You reached the clash in time. Mara rode out of the smoke unhurt.
The Aurelian column is broken. The Crown is in your debt.
The hired blades are broken. Neither army fired a shot. The envoys wait in the parley tent.

events.text: A tournament at Vessara: eight fighters on foot. Entries close on day 31.
The militia of Highmere drilled alone.
The militia of Dunmarsh drilled alone.

lines.text: Valedorn and Aurelian patrols came to blows near Eastwatch. The Valedorn riders held the field.
A courier is stuck in Merrow with a letter for Tessaro.
A tournament at Stonebridge: eight fighters on foot. Entries close on day 22.
Road Reavers fell on Hrothmark wagons near Tessaro. Timber will cost more in Hrothgard for a while.
The militia of Highmere is calling for veterans to drill them, fearing the border.
A tournament at Hrothgard: eight fighters on foot. Entries close on day 28.
Vessaro soldiers broke a band of Road Reavers near Torre Salina.
Bad blood between Aurelian and Vessaro after a border incident near Marenna. Their patrols eye each other in the southern coast.
